encoding: Esplora transparent envelope: four complete transactions including HogEx, no extension presence byte or body

decoder_contract.block: Strict Core encoding; complete HogEx must be followed by an extension presence byte and complete body when present
decoder_contract.esplora_block: Explicit provider encoding; exact EOF after complete HogEx also accepted; any present suffix parsed fully
decoder_contract.result: bitcoin::Block is a transparent read projection, not the original Litecoin serialization; preserve original bytes independently for proofs and wire storage
decoder_contract.integrity: Requested header hash, transparent transaction Merkle root and witness commitment checked; Bitcoin network-specific PoW checks remain at native callers
decoder_contract.unsupported: Transactions with embedded confidential MWEB data, including MWEB-only transactions, fail closed
decoder_contract.limits: 8,000,000 input bytes as a client resource limit, not a Litecoin consensus weight limit; canonical roundtrip and end-of-input required
decoder_contract.limitations: No MWEB consensus, range-proof, kernel-signature, extension commitment, chain-work or Litecoin scrypt validation. Structural parsing of an extension body does not authenticate its contents. This reader is for transparent URMA observations.

dependency.usage: Bounded structural transaction and MWEB body parsing only; never use its compute_wtxid for MWEB/HogEx
dependency.corrections: Core excludes MWEB metadata from ordinary txid/wtxid; strip only HogEx metadata before bitcoin hashing. Embedded MWEB transactions are rejected. Block extension presence follows HogEx without the crate's additional header-version-bit condition.
